fields.issue: The CAX8 paper linear result is 30.21717 MPa versus published 27.53 MPa. Full 3D refinement gives 34.34704, 30.80495 and 30.28896 MPa, approaching CAX8 within0.24%; nonaxisymmetric modes at this resolution do not remove the roughly10% discrepancy. Elastic Gaussian-dimple endpoints exceed the published nonlinear pressures by over2x. No calibrated transfer of knockdown is established. The paper uses continuum-shell faces and tie constraints; ours uses conforming solid elements. No isolated cause for the linear discrepancy is claimed. Figure4 and the brief specify42.8mm radius; the conclusion says41.8mm. We use42.8mm and retain the text ambiguity.
